plain: To make remarkable or mark out by a notable act

webster.text: To make remarkable or eminent; to render distinguished from what is common.

example.quote: In that country, it has been uniformly found that those members, who are chosen by numerous respectable electors, make the greatest opposition to oppression and corruption, and signalize themselves for the preservation of liberty.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 7, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
